governing_question: After everything that died, narrowed, or was redesigned in 4.1–4.5, do the surviving pieces still form one coherent political-economic system?
stance: This pass attacks the joins, not the modules. No new ideas. No new research lane. Reconcile what survived and close Stage 4.

project_build_distinction.statement: 100% PROJECT BUILD ≠ final public book finished.
project_build_distinction.means: The full technical system has been built, written, attacked, and certified.
project_build_distinction.next: Stage 5 is compression: the ~100-page Public Book — not more theory-building.

join_tests.title: Fiscal ↔ Legal
questions: Did 4.2 legal constraints remove mechanisms that 4.1 still assumes?
Do surviving public-income concepts remain legally usable?
Does the tax-transition map still match constitutional/statutory pathways?
Are any fiscal claims relying on L-D/L-E mechanisms?
join_tests.finding: 4.1 waterfall + COUNTABLE=$0 remain; dual abolition FAILED before and after legal attack. Surviving public-income concepts require L-A/L-B pathways (4.2). Art. 16 §1 kills private debt guarantees assumed by soft-budget enterprises. No fiscal claim may rest on L-D/L-E. Tax-transition map is aspirational sequencing, not near-term COUNTABLE policy.
join_tests.reconcile: Public-income concepts tagged with pathway grades; L-D/L-E demoted to LEGAL_CHANGE_REQUIRED or FAILED.

join_tests.title: Fiscal ↔ Household
questions: Do surviving revenue mechanisms improve or burden Household Prosperity?
Did 4.3 tax incidence undermine assumed household gains?
Are we claiming prosperity from state revenue while households worsen?
join_tests.finding: Household remains unit of success (4.1 lock). Incidence and capitalization (4.3) mean revenue design without transmission testing is invalid. Scarcity absorbers (housing, care) can nullify fiscal 'wins.' No surviving claim asserts household prosperity from state revenue alone.
join_tests.reconcile: Any fiscal proposal must pass household transmission + scarcity absorption checks.

join_tests.title: Fiscal ↔ Resilience
join_tests.key_test: Can a replacement revenue architecture survive a shock without restoring the very taxes it claimed to replace?
join_tests.finding: Near-term dual abolition FAILED under stress (4.4). Replacement-ready requires Diversified waterfall clearance + Revenue Concentration Rule + Resilience Waterfall + federal classification. Current architecture is NOT replacement-ready. Waterfall correctly refuses fake cash.
join_tests.reconcile: Replacement-ready is CONDITIONAL/UNPROVEN until COUNTABLE + shock survival proven. Dependency Rule retained.

join_tests.title: Public ownership ↔ Competition ↔ Governance
join_tests.question: Is there still a coherent, narrow case for any public ownership/investment?

surviving_standard.name: Narrow Public Ownership / Investment Standard
surviving_standard.rule: If a proposed asset cannot pass all gates, it does not belong.

join_tests.finding: Default public ownership FAILED (4.1/4.2). Narrow case SURVIVES only under the eight-gate standard. Winner-picking FAILED (4.5). Failure Firewall required (4.4).
join_tests.reconcile: Single canonical standard replaces scattered ownership language.

join_tests.title: Localism ↔ Rights ↔ Capacity
join_tests.final_rule: Local where capable and lawful; state support where scale or capacity requires it; constitutional rights never depend on ZIP code.
join_tests.finding: Localism without rights floor FAILED (4.5). Pure pilot autonomy without enabling law FAILED (4.2). Pilot→statewide leap FAILED (4.3). Coherent stack SURVIVES.
join_tests.reconcile: Final localism rule locked as stated.

join_tests.title: AI ↔ Due Process ↔ Administrative reality
join_tests.finding: Black-box public power FAILED. AI Public Power rule SURVIVES. OV-35-05 legal edges remain UNPROVEN—uncertainty preserved; no manufactured bright line. Mediocre Government Test requires explainable, appealable administration.
join_tests.reconcile: Three-tier AI power map; OV-35-05 stays UNPROVEN where edges remain.

join_tests.title: Human capability ↔ AI disruption
join_tests.finding: Retraining-as-universal-fix FAILED (4.4). Continuous capability matters, but ownership, transition support, labor-market structure, time, and distribution of productivity gains also matter. No surviving chapter may imply education alone solves AI disruption.
join_tests.reconcile: Part III / human-capital language demoted from 'education solves AI' to multi-factor transition doctrine.

join_tests.title: Productive retention ↔ Trade ↔ Household affordability
join_tests.final_principle: Retain value when doing so builds net Arkansas capability and prosperity—not merely because the producer is geographically local.
join_tests.finding: Retention-always-good FAILED (4.1). Buy-local moral premium FAILED (4.3). Blanket Arkansas-first procurement FAILED (4.2). Comparative advantage + household affordability + external income remain load-bearing.
join_tests.reconcile: Final retention principle replaces residual protectionist localism language.

join_tests.title: Growth ↔ Housing ↔ Infrastructure ↔ Population
acknowledgments: Population growth without capacity growth can reduce prosperity.
Graceful Contraction remains valid where population falls.
join_tests.finding: Population-growth scoreboard FAILED (4.3/4.4). Growth Absorption Capacity + housing supply (4.3) + Retain/Return/Attract/Belong join water, transport, healthcare, schools, care. Coherent.
join_tests.reconcile: Growth strategies must pass absorption capacity; decline strategies may use Graceful Contraction.

join_tests.title: Household Prosperity ↔ Intergenerational Capital
join_tests.balanced_rule: Meet legitimate present necessities while preserving and expanding the productive capacity required for future prosperity.
join_tests.finding: Conflict is real—not pretended away. Present Necessity vs Future Capability (4.4) + Drawdown Rule + essential-function floors reconcile the moral tension. Neither present neglect nor future looting survives.
join_tests.reconcile: Balanced rule + explicit conflict protocol locked.

join_tests.title: Democracy ↔ Expertise ↔ Measurement
join_tests.hierarchy: Evidence informs. Experts administer. Institutions constrain. Citizens govern.
locks: Experts do not become sovereign because a subject is complicated.
No single prosperity number substitutes for the household ledger.
join_tests.finding: Metric Gaming + Comprehensible Government + HP panel join citizen sovereignty without technocracy. Coherent.
join_tests.reconcile: Hierarchy locked; magic score remains FAILED.

join_tests.title: Anti-capture ↔ Administrative usability
join_tests.question: Did we add so many safeguards that nobody can actually govern?
join_tests.finding: Breaker hierarchy prefers simpler structural protections first (4.5). Administrative Load Ratio disclosure required. Safeguards whose cost exceeds risk reduction are flagged for redesign—not piled forever. Goal: bounded government, not procedural paralysis. Mediocre Government Test co-equal with Dictator Test.
join_tests.reconcile: Usability gate attached to every new breaker; Load Ratio required.

join_tests.title: Resilience ↔ Efficiency
join_tests.finding: Efficiency/resilience principle SURVIVED (4.4). Not every duplicated system is resilience. Strategic Capacity ≠ autarky. Classification required for resilience spends.

join_tests.title: Transition ↔ Democratic durability
questions: What can safely change by ordinary statute?
What must not be locked away from future democratic choice?
join_tests.finding: Continuity without locking future Arkansans out of self-government. Constitutional protection candidates (4.5) are flags—not automatic amendments. Future sovereignty preserved. Ordinary policy remains reversible; core rights floors and COUNTABLE firewalls get stronger protection.
join_tests.reconcile: Durability menu (4.5) applied: statute / institution / voter / constitutional candidate.

join_tests.title: Constitutional Capitalism crash test
join_tests.scenario: Early years go well → public assets accumulate → household metrics improve → then recession + major employer failure + hostile administration + federal funding decline + housing supply tightens simultaneously.
join_tests.finding: Logic holds if and only if: Resilience Waterfall + Drawdown Rule + essential floors + Failure Firewall + Opposition/Least-Trusted Operator + HP transmission + Growth Absorption (housing) + Public Deal Ledger discipline + no 'good leadership fixes it' escape hatch. Any model step that requires virtuous politicians is a defect—none remain in the certified path.
join_tests.reconcile: Crash-test pathway is the certified stress narrative for Stage 5 compression.

phases.state: Assets accumulate; household metrics improve; transition underway

crash_test.defect_rule: Any step that says 'and then good leadership fixes it' is a defect.
